user_intent: Requesting a serial dilution protocol for the Opentrons OT-2 (likely as an executable Opentrons Protocol API script).

tools.name: opentrons_simulate
tools.notes: Official CLI included with the Opentrons Python package; analyzes and simulates Protocol API v2 Python protocols locally, printing the command timeline and raising API/labware errors without needing a robot.

simulation_validation.notes: Local simulation loads the protocol in a ProtocolContext, detects Python/API errors, labware definition issues, and some pipette/volume constraints; it does not check robot calibration or physical execution.
